name: prompt-forge
description: prompt-forge: forges your loose prompts and goals into outcome-focused briefs for Claude Code.

plugins.name: prompt-forge
plugins.description: Forges the first prompt you send in a session, your large prompts and every /goal you set into an outcome-focused brief behind an isolated model call, so the agent never sees your loose wording.

plugins.name: prompt-forge-view
plugins.description: Shows prompt-forge's forged prompts in the chat, the desktop app included.
